Kon! Sensei Zenko here. Today in 心理: do the practice below, then ask me anything on the right page~
Concept: Causality · Context: Learning and cognition
How has the concept of causality shaped how psychologists study social learning?
Causality: Can we say X causes Y? Only experiments show cause and effect; correlations and observations can't.
Which term? “Defining a variable so it can be measured (e.g. 'stress' = cortisol level).”

• Health and well-being: Interview (structured, semi-structured or focus group)
• Human development: Observation (naturalistic or controlled, overt or covert, participant or non-participant)
• Human relationships: Survey/questionnaire (closed and open questions, at least 10 participants)
• Learning and cognition: Experiment (true or quasi-experiment, at least 5 participants)
